items.root_cause: Check (d) asks whether a product name carries the ingredient's head word, and three different things make a right product fail that test: (1) the tokenizer is ASCII-only, so an accented letter becomes a word break and 'Gruyère' never equals 'gruyere' (the same defect class pull-regular-bakers-api.ps1 fixed for its own names on 'Crème Brûlée'); (2) a product name omits a qualifier that no capture field records (fat level of an olive oil mayo, oil vs dry pack of sun-dried tomatoes), so no word test can ever decide it and only a label read or a standing key can; (3) the keyed mark is written only by an explicit -Tighten that c989c6 owed after landing, and the landing came after the daily build, so the owed tighten never ran and every right-cell finding re-pages as a RISE. The Tony Chachere key is not a rule defect: the exclude works on the live rules and today's board simply predates it.

surface_fix.what: none on the board. The Tony Chachere Fareway row leaves cajun-seasoning on the 2026-09-29 build by the rule already on main.

root_fix.what: Fold diacritics in the identity tokenizer before the ASCII strip, so a name that spells the ingredient with an accent names it; leave the finding KEY functions untouched so every existing mark key stays byte-identical.
root_fix.exact_change: In meal-prep/lib/ingredient-identity-lib.ps1 add function ConvertTo-IdentityFoldedText([string]$Text): return $Text.Normalize([Text.NormalizationForm]::FormD) with every char whose [Globalization.CharUnicodeInfo]::GetUnicodeCategory is NonSpacingMark removed, then .Normalize(FormC) (the same shape as grocery/pull-regular-bakers-api.ps1:359-362). Call it in Get-IdentityTokens line 50 before .ToLower() and in Test-PricingRowNamesIngredient line 103 before .ToLower(). Do NOT call it in ConvertTo-IdentityStoreKey (line 123) or ConvertTo-IdentityProductKey (line 208): the keys must not move, or every accented standing key re-pages as a RISE. Build accented fixture strings from [char]0x00E8 / [char]0x00F1, never a literal, because a BOM-less .ps1 is read as ANSI under PS 5.1.
